accepted.label: Maximax (Optimistic) Criterion
accepted.description: An optimistic decision rule where one selects the alternative with the maximum possible payoff (best outcome). For profits, maximize the maximum; for costs, minimize the minimum. This concept covers identifying the maximax choice from a payoff table and explaining its optimistic nature.
coverage_criteria: Given a payoff table, apply the maximax criterion to select the alternative with the best possible outcome.
Explain the optimistic philosophy behind the maximax rule.
accepted.merge_rationale: Both candidates teach the same core concept: the optimistic maximax decision rule. Student actions are identical (applying the rule to a payoff table and explaining its optimistic nature), despite different depth labels.
